recalls.summary: Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2018 Legacy, Outback, and BRZ vehicles.  In the affected vehicles, a software issue may cause the audio display system to not initialize, resulting in the camera display remaining blank.  If this occurs, the rearview image will not display while backing up the vehicle.  As a result, the vehicles fail to comply with requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety (FMVSS) number 111, "Rearview Mirrors."
